title: Worker timing (start/end, active vs human-wait) + token (in/out) and cost accounting per worker/run, logged on existing owners
body: Observe per-worker and per-run: start/end timestamps, active work duration, time blocked on human approval/response/input (tracked separately), input/output tokens, and cost. Reuses WorkerResult (core/worker.py), the task metrics block (core/task_contract.set_metrics), the worker-results store, and core.cost_model.token_cost for cost - no new store.
